title: The 5 Best Mattress Toppers for Side Sleepers
h1: The 5 Best Mattress Toppers for Side Sleepers
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for mattress toppers for side sleepers, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at mattress toppers for side sleepers using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Lucid 3-Inch Gel Memory Foam Topper
products.blurb: Key specs: 3-inch gel-infused memory foam, 5-zone design, CertiPUR-US certified foam.
strengths: 3-inch depth provides enough cushioning at the hip and shoulder for most side sleepers without feeling like sleeping on a cloud
5-zone design gives a bit more give at the shoulders and hips specifically, where side sleepers need it most
Ventilated channels reduce heat buildup better than solid memory foam slabs
limitations: Off-gassing smell for the first 24 to 48 hours after unboxing
3-inch density feels firmer than some dual-layer competitors out of the box
No corner straps included, so it can shift under a fitted sheet on a slippery mattress
features: Fits in a standard fitted sheet

products.name: Sleep Innovations 4-Inch Topper
products.blurb: Key specs: 3-inch cooling gel memory foam plus 1-inch fluffy pillow top, Dual-layer construction, Removable, washable cover.
strengths: The 1-inch quilted pillow top adds an extra plush layer that side sleepers with bony hips and shoulders tend to prefer
Dual-layer design separates cushioning from support, so the foam underneath doesn't bottom out as fast as a single-layer topper
Washable cover is a genuine convenience most single-layer toppers lack
limitations: 4-inch total height can make fitted sheets difficult to secure on a mattress already at max depth
Plush feel means less correction for a genuinely sagging older mattress
Softer profile is less suited to combination sleepers who also spend time on their stomach
features: 3-inch cooling gel memory foam plus 1-inch fluffy pillow top

products.name: Linenspa Gel Memory Foam Topper
products.blurb: Key specs: 3-inch gel-infused memory foam, Plush feel, CertiPUR-US certified.
strengths: 3-inch depth gives adequate hip and shoulder relief at the lowest price point
Gel infusion noticeably reduces the heat retention typical of cheaper memory foam
limitations: Foam density is lower than the Lucid, so it compresses faster over 12 to 18 months of nightly use
Edge support is minimal, noticeable for side sleepers who sleep near the edge of the mattress
Cover is thin and not removable for washing

products.name: Tempur-Pedic Supreme Topper
products.blurb: Key specs: 3-inch proprietary TEMPUR material, Corner straps for a secure fit, Machine-washable cover with Safe-Guard technology.
strengths: Corner straps keep the topper from sliding, a common complaint with budget toppers
10-year warranty is far longer than any other topper in this list
Reduced motion transfer benefits side sleepers sharing a bed with a partner who moves at night
limitations: Denser material retains more warmth than gel-infused competitors despite the washable cover
features: Corner straps for a secure fit

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
